title: ENERGUN FM-1 CORE autonomous development infrastructure

workstreams.title: Repository-wide CI concurrency coordination
workstreams.implementation: A trusted GitHub Actions coordinator now writes exact-SHA requests to the provisioned energun-ci-queue Git-ref ledger. Three lane-specific workers consume the shared ledger. Git-ref non-forced updates provide CAS serialization; enqueue is idempotent. Real queue records, claims and terminal evidence are visible on the data branch. The live worker lanes have been exercised; final contention/no-loss qualification remains open.
workstreams.limitation: This is a durable queue with atomic CAS claims, not a single global mutex. Full stress qualification across many simultaneous enqueues and complete draining of the current backlog remain open. Untrusted pull-request code receives no queue-write token.

workstreams.title: Coding worker registry and capability model
acceptance: Worker identity, capabilities, availability and version are recorded
Workers have least-privilege repository permissions
No worker receives physical-device or main-branch write permissions
Registry schema and unsafe policy rejection are covered by automated tests
workstreams.implementation: A runtime worker registry is now persisted inside the shared queue ledger. GitHub Actions CP1/CP2/CP3 workers enroll with unique worker ID, run ID, lane, capabilities and concurrency; state and active request are updated atomically through available/busy/offline. Real worker records have been observed in the live ledger.
workstreams.limitation: Only trusted GitHub Actions test/build workers are connected. No autonomous AI coding agent is registered. Worker health heartbeats during long-running tasks and retention/compaction of old registry entries need further hardening.

workstreams.title: Automatic task routing and assignment
acceptance: Task type and acceptance criteria select a qualified worker
Dependencies, concurrency budget and worker availability are enforced
Assignments and outcomes are auditable
Dry-run routing and safety constraints are covered by automated tests
workstreams.implementation: Live lane workers now claim exact-SHA tasks through the persistent registry. Every claim checks the worker lane, capacity, global three-worker limit and declared DAG prerequisites. Claims use CAS, attempt fencing and exact-SHA completion evidence. Unit tests cover blocked dependencies, three independent claims and two distinct workers competing for one task.
workstreams.limitation: The production lane DAG currently declares CP1/CP2/CP3 independent; dependency gating is validated with a parent/child test DAG. General CP8 feature-task authoring and AI code generation are not connected.

workstreams.title: Isolated feature branches and workspaces
acceptance: Each coding task uses a dedicated branch/worktree
Branch base SHA and allowed paths are recorded
Concurrent workers cannot overwrite each other's changes

workstreams.title: Bounded autonomous source-code changes
acceptance: Worker receives a bounded task specification and file scope
Changes are diff-reviewed and do not touch protected paths
Worker cannot merge or access physical hardware

workstreams.title: Automated validation and evidence collection
acceptance: Relevant tests and target builds run on the exact task commit
Logs, artifacts, timing and exit status are retained
BLOCKED and FAIL are never converted into PASS

workstreams.title: Automatic reviewable pull request creation
acceptance: PR includes scope, diff summary, tests and evidence
PR targets an approved integration branch, never main by default
PR remains open for human review and is never auto-merged

workstreams.title: Independent review and quality gate
acceptance: Review is performed independently of the authoring worker
Required checks and evidence are verified
Unresolved review findings block promotion

workstreams.title: Conflict prevention, idempotency and recovery
acceptance: Task IDs and idempotency keys prevent duplicate execution
Stale leases and abandoned workspaces can be recovered safely
Conflicting PRs are detected before integration
workstreams.implementation: Atomic queue claims, idempotency, per-attempt fencing and job-level recovery are implemented. A live CP1 Actions job was terminated while owning a running task; a later worker reclaimed the same request with attempts incremented to 2, and the exact-SHA task then passed. Old worker identity was retired.
workstreams.limitation: Further repeated crash/replay tests, simultaneous contention stress and long-running worker heartbeat qualification remain open.
